intended_baupa_use_case_draft.SOURCE: INFERENCE grounded in CODE_EVIDENCE product behavior
intended_baupa_use_case_draft.summary: HubChat is a multi-agent shared inbox. When a Facebook Messenger customer messages the connected Page, HubChat looks up the Page-scoped user profile to display the customer's name and profile picture in the Inbox conversation list and conversation header so human agents can visually identify and distinguish customers while responding.
why_necessary: Visual identification of Messenger customers in a dense conversation list
Reduce mis-selection among similarly named customers
Improve agent usability during live customer support
intended_baupa_use_case_draft.fields_justification: Limited to Messenger User Profile fields needed for Inbox display; HubChat does not request locale/timezone/gender for this use case.
intended_baupa_use_case_draft.who_can_access: Authenticated HubChat tenant users (agents/admins) for the tenant that owns the Facebook Page connection.
intended_baupa_use_case_draft.storage: Display name and profile image URL persisted on contact_identities/contacts/conversations for Inbox rendering; optional avatar cache feature exists but is not required for the BAUPA justification.
intended_baupa_use_case_draft.retention_deletion: UNKNOWN exact tenant retention policy text for App Review form — must be filled from product/privacy policy before submission.
explicitly_not_claimed: Re-identifiable marketing profiling beyond Inbox support UX
